title: notme-2025-03-21-0931.mp3
text:
my mom told me to eat broccoli
or else i'd die
now she tells me to buy property
to live an easy life
i dont know what to say to that
i dont have any money for that
who the fuck's gonna pay for that?
(not me)
my mom told me to eat healthy
and it didnt help me
at all
i'm so stressed these days
cant get dressed each day
im impressed i'm not a mess, like the rest would say
so im gonna keep on renting my place
and im gonna keep on keeping my pace
half of the time i just need some space
(some space)
